cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Orders from the Shadows
cards.instruction: Hide that you set the problem in motion while quietly directing how everyone responds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll rebuild the wedding bookings. Could you reassure the couples? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cancellation log has your initials.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Keep that screen here. Give them the replacement dates; I'll handle the log.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can restore everything, but they'll get an email naming whoever cancelled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's helpful. Restore the dates individually instead; I'll stay and read them out.

mechanism: A claims control of restoring canceled bookings but accepts extra manual work alongside B to prevent the recovery process exposing A initiating action.
confusable: Unlike simply repairing a mistake, A controls disclosure of authorship; confidence depends on keeping B willing to use the slower recovery path.
comparison: Booking log and restore notifications differ from shipment emails and event timelines.
seedUse: Use D61-b initials/canceled dates/restore email/manual recovery with S02-b taking a supporting role to retain cooperation.
